integrity: Proved deterministic structural-identifiability statement; standalone standard-library supplementary arithmetic checks are not an independent proof or an observational accuracy assessment.
scientific_limitations: Exact analytic point-source point-lens flux model with fixed positive source and blend fluxes. No finite-source, parallax, binary lens, intrinsic variability, noise, or nonstationary backgrounds. Sixth-order derivatives can be severely noise sensitive; high impact parameters are ill-conditioned. No empirical validation claimed.
title: Sixth-order peak jets sharply identify blended point-lens microlensing across arbitrarily many passbands
